title: Student Details
subtitle: A form that saves the student's SID, name and grade, then shows them on a profile screen.

nodes.label: Drag a Header, type: Student Details
Command: ADD CHOICE "Grade" OPTIONS "Grade 1 ... Grade 12"
nodes.note: A drop-down list gives clean data.

nodes.label: Commands: ADD BUTTON "Save Details" and SET ACTION ... SAVE "students"
nodes.note: SAVE stores the form in the students collection.

nodes.label: Create the My Profile screen: NAVIGATE TO, ADD HEADER, ADD LATEST
nodes.note: A second screen that shows the saved details.

nodes.label: Command: LINK BUTTON "Save Details" TO "My Profile"
Run Project and fill in your details
Are SID, name and grade all filled in?
Message: Please fill in the missing field
nodes.note: The form will not save until every box is filled.

nodes.label: Save the record in "students"
nodes.note: Stored on the device. Module 3 reads it.

nodes.label: My Profile shows the saved details
